policy_title: Raise Police Standards and Tackle Fraud
stated: Labour will reform the police by giving His Majesty’s Inspectorate new powers to intervene with failing forces. They will introduce mandatory professional standards for vetting, checks, and misconduct, with stronger training on racism and violence against women and girls. Individuals with a history of violence against women and girls will be barred, and officers investigated for domestic abuse/sexual offences automatically suspended. New legal safeguards will be introduced for strip-searching children and young people. Labour will also introduce a new expanded fraud strategy, working with technology companies to prevent platform exploitation.

source.quote: Labour will turn the page and raise standards by reforming the police. Labour will give His Majesty’s Inspectorate of Constabulary, Fire & Rescue Services new powers to intervene with failing forces. We will introduce mandatory professional standards on vetting, checks and misconduct for individual officers; and stronger training on racism and violence against women and girls. Anyone with a history of violence against women and girls will be barred from the service and we will introduce automatic suspensions if officers are investigated for domestic abuse and sexual offences. Particular care is required when investigating children. Labour will introduce new legal safeguards around strip-searching children and young people. Labour will introduce a new expanded fraud strategy to tackle the full range of threats, including online, public sector and serious fraud. We will work with technology companies to stop their platforms being exploited by fraudsters.

bearing_set.reason: Core police reform measures (intervention powers, vetting/misconduct standards, VAWG barring, automatic suspension, fraud strategy) directly affect crime prevention, policing quality, and public safety outcomes.
New legal safeguards for strip-searching children are explicitly a due-process/civil-liberties measure; mandatory racism standards and misconduct vetting directly touch equal treatment protections.

New legal safeguards specifically governing strip-searching of children and young people directly restrict a coercive, bodily-invasive state practice — a concrete mechanism improving bodily autonomy and freedom from undue state coercion for that group.

membership_note: Three fundamentals are genuinely in play: safety/justice (O5) via fraud strategy and police quality reform; equal treatment (O9) via anti-discrimination vetting and VAWG standards; and personal liberty (O10) via strip-search safeguards for children. No material fiscal, housing, health, or other lever is moved non-negligibly.
